Definition: Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Beth-Horon means "house of hollowness." It was two towns in Ephraim, Upper and Lower Beth-Horon. It turns up in Joshua 10:10, Joshua 10:11 and Joshua 16:3.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Beth-Horon matters because the land itself is part of the promise. God gave real towns with real names, and the victory there is still on the map.
